scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

discardCards.title: Panzer Run
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Airport Locker
discardCards.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: Swiss Bank Account
discardCards.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Elena Laskova
rig.rulesText: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effect. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

ice.title: Canis Major
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.
